lane:
فيهج

فَيْهَجٌ _A wine-measure:_ (S, O, K:) a Pers. word arabicized [and therefore all its letters are regarded as radical]. (S.) === And _A strainer_ (O, K, TA) _for wine._ (TA.) === And (sometimes, S, O) a name for _Wine:_ (S, K:) or _clear wine:_ (O, TA:) or an epithet applied to wine [app. signifying _clear_]: (TA:) or _wine such as is_ مختلق [app. a mistranscription for مُخَلَّق, a word now used as signifying _aromatized_]; like قِنْدِيدٌ [q. v.] and أُمٌّ زَنْبَقٍ. (IAmb, TA.)
